sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r13/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 15 / sheet row 16; Internal Quality Checks row 15, no annotation on it; Deterministic Checks rows check-dockerfiles.py, check-dockerfile-references.sh, check-fixtures.py, check-package-manifest-deps-preinstalled.py, check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (searched for Dockerfile/pinning guidance; relevant passages read)
evidence: task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...467d1) is byte-identical to the frozen template environment/Dockerfile (diff empty), so every template-controlled setting is preserved. Pinned: 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim' (tag-pinned exactly as the template; no digest is required by the workbook wording or check-dockerfiles.py) and 'express@5.1.0', 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' installed globally with 'ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules', matching NODE_PATH in tests/test.sh and the same two pins in tests/Dockerfile. Unpinned apt packages (ca-certificates git procps sqlite3) are a NOTE under check-dockerfiles.py, not a failure. Runtime dependencies: solution/app/server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3; the frontend packages named in package.json (react, react-dom, prettier, acorn, acorn-walk, @lezer/html) are compiled into the committed public/assets/index.js (1.9 MB, single module, no external http(s) script or chunk URL in public/index.html), so nothing else is needed at launch. solution/solve.sh contains no npm/apt/pip/curl/wget step: it only removes the old database and 'cp -a' the app to /app. The manifest packages not present in the image are therefore a NOTE only (check-package-manifest-deps-preinstalled.py: NOTE under public network), not a run-time install. Assets staged: 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/' with 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; both source directories exist (six notes, seed_data.json parses), and instruction.md and integration.md refer to exactly /instructions and /assets/seed_data.json. /app is created, git-initialised and holds only .gitkeep. No COPY of solution/ or tests/. task.toml sets no [environment].docker_image, and integration.md's statement 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH' matches the image. Adversarial probes: (a) a broken app relying on an unlisted global module cannot pass, since the verifier image carries the same two globals only; (b) a conforming alternative that vendors its own /app/node_modules is accepted by test.sh (symlinks inside /app/node_modules allowed) and /app is a declared artifact, so it is not failed by this image. Measurement: scripted golden evidence shows the golden installed by solve.sh and launched as uid 65534 with env -i and NODE_PATH in an agent-image container, surviving a real process restart (results/restart.json shows revision 2, history [2,1]); the hosted run on an earlier candidate built and ran the agent environment (Oracle 0.9833). Limitation, recorded and not waived: run_golden.sh uses a pre-built image tag (CW_AGENT_IMAGE default 'cw-editor-agent-r3') and the index does not record a docker build of environment/Dockerfile from these exact bytes nor an image-to-Dockerfile hash link; the claim that the image builds rests on the Dockerfile being unchanged template bytes plus the earlier hosted build. No configured judge run exists for these bytes.
